Device Rings on Successive calls, if a call was missed in Silent or Vibrate Mode.\n\nNotifications can be dismissed to disable the ringing.

Quickly change ringer modes by double pressing volume buttons when the screen is on

To use this feature, the app needs access to the volume buttons of the device. This is managed by the Accessibility permission.
Press continue to provide these in the settings menu.
 
This permission is only needed to access the volume buttons and no other information is used or created.

Device Rings on if a call is received from marked Contacts, if the device is in silent or Vibrate mode.

To use this app permisions are needed to read Contacts and detect incoming calls. Press continue to provide these in the app settings menu
Long press to alert favourite contact
Device rings on receiving the Notification message "Quiet Exceptional Alarm" from selected contacts. Long-press to send Alarm to Favourite contact. Carrier Charges may apply.

The app lets you set up subtle pings after missed calls and rings Exceptional Alarms on receiving alarm messages.

Quiet Exceptional reads Notifications to detect these and operates DND settings if needed.\n\nNo Data leaves the device without user intervention and Quiet Exceptional does not need Internet Access to function.

Temporarily silence the device. DND mode is removed after the set duration. For best experience, drag from the top and add to Quick Settings.
Drag down from the top to open Quick Settings. Add Temp DND to Quick Settings for best experience.
